document_version: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), English OJ text snapshot stored under references/winter_2020_model_check/model_check/input/regulations/gdpr

methods_contract.winter: native full pipeline; not sharing Stage1/Stage3

requirements.source_locator: Where the controller intends to further process
tasks: Complete direct collection and identify a new processing purpose
Provide information on the other purpose prior to further processing
Carry out further processing for the other purpose
requirements.order_evidence: prior to that further processing
requirements.constraint_text: prior to that further processing
requirements.exception_text: the data subject already has the information under Article 13(4)
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 直接收集后拟进一步处理，须在进一步处理前告知新目的。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Further processing of directly collected personal data requires prior notice.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide the data subject with the other purpose and relevant information before further processing.

requirements.source_locator: Where the controller intends to further process
tasks: Complete indirect collection and identify a new processing purpose
Provide information on the other purpose prior to further processing
Carry out further processing for the other purpose
requirements.order_evidence: prior to that further processing
requirements.constraint_text: prior to that further processing
requirements.exception_text: the data subject already has the information or Article 14(5) applies
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 间接收集后拟进一步处理，须在进一步处理前告知新目的。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Further processing of indirectly obtained personal data requires prior notice.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide the data subject with the other purpose and relevant further information before further processing.

requirements.source_locator: A data subject who has obtained restriction
tasks: Confirm that the grounds for lifting the restriction are met
Inform the data subject that the restriction will be lifted
Lift the restriction of processing
requirements.order_evidence: before the restriction of processing is lifted
requirements.constraint_text: before the restriction of processing is lifted
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 解除处理限制前，控制者须告知数据主体。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must inform the data subject before lifting a processing restriction.
requirements.normative_content: The controller must inform the data subject before the restriction of processing is lifted.

requirements.source_locator: Where a type of processing in particular using new technologies
tasks: Describe the envisaged high-risk processing
Carry out the data protection impact assessment
Begin the assessed processing operations
requirements.order_evidence: prior to the processing
requirements.condition_text: processing likely to result in high risk to rights and freedoms
requirements.constraint_text: prior to the processing
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 高风险处理前，控制者须开展数据保护影响评估。
requirements.business_scenario_en: High-risk processing requires a prior DPIA.
requirements.normative_content: The controller shall carry out a DPIA prior to high-risk processing.

requirements.source_locator: The controller shall consult the supervisory authority prior to processing
tasks: Review the DPIA indicating high residual risk
Consult the supervisory authority about the proposed processing
Start the proposed processing
requirements.order_evidence: prior to processing
requirements.condition_text: DPIA indicates high risk in the absence of mitigating measures
requirements.constraint_text: prior to processing
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 评估显示无缓解措施时仍有高风险，控制者须事先咨询监管机构。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Prior consultation is required when high residual risk remains.
requirements.normative_content: The controller shall consult the supervisory authority prior to processing when the DPIA indicates high risk without mitigation.

requirements.source_locator: Where processing is based on consent, the controller shall be able to demonstrate
tasks: Receive and record the data subject consent
Demonstrate that consent was given
Store the consent evidence
requirements.order_evidence: shall be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented
requirements.constraint_text: shall be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 基于同意处理时，控制者须能够证明数据主体已同意。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must be able to demonstrate consent.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must keep evidence that the data subject consented.

requirements.source_locator: When assessing whether consent is freely given
tasks: Identify whether performance of a contract or service is conditional on consent
Assess whether the consent is freely given
Record the assessment of free consent
requirements.order_evidence: When assessing whether consent is freely given
requirements.condition_text: performance of a contract or service is conditional on unnecessary processing
requirements.constraint_text: When assessing whether consent is freely given
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 评估同意是否自由作出时，须考虑服务附条件于非必要处理的情形。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Freely given consent assessment must consider conditional service provision.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must assess whether consent is freely given, including conditional-service situations.

requirements.source_locator: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation
tasks: Receive the access request
Provide confirmation and access to the personal data
Provide the required access information
requirements.order_evidence: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation
requirements.constraint_text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 数据主体有权获得是否处理其个人数据的确认及访问。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The data subject has a right of access and confirmation.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide confirmation and access to the personal data.

requirements.source_locator: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller without undue delay
tasks: Receive the rectification request
Rectify inaccurate personal data without undue delay
Confirm the rectification to the data subject
requirements.order_evidence: without undue delay
requirements.constraint_text: without undue delay
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 数据主体有权要求控制者及时更正不准确个人数据。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The data subject has a right to rectification without undue delay.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must rectify inaccurate personal data without undue delay.

requirements.source_locator: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure
tasks: Receive the erasure request and assess an applicable ground
Erase personal data without undue delay
Record the erasure decision
requirements.order_evidence: without undue delay
requirements.constraint_text: without undue delay
requirements.exception_text: Article 17(3) exceptions may apply
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 存在法定事由时，控制者须及时删除个人数据。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must erase personal data without undue delay when a ground applies.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must erase personal data without undue delay where one of the Article 17(1) grounds applies.

requirements.source_locator: The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data
tasks: Receive the portability request
Provide the personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format
Transmit the data to another controller without hindrance
requirements.order_evidence: The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data
requirements.condition_text: processing based on consent or contract and carried out by automated means
requirements.constraint_text: The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data
requirements.exception_text: Article 20(4) public-interest or official-authority exception
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 符合条件时，控制者须以结构化、通用、机器可读格式提供个人数据。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Data portability requires a machine-readable format when conditions are met.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide portable data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

requirements.source_locator: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay
tasks: Become aware of the personal data breach
Notify the competent supervisory authority
Document the notification or reasons for delay
requirements.order_evidence: without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware
requirements.condition_text: breach unlikely to result in a risk may exempt notification
requirements.constraint_text: without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware
requirements.exception_text: breach unlikely to result in a risk to rights and freedoms
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 发生个人数据泄露时，控制者须在知悉后及时且不迟于72小时通知监管机构。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must notify the supervisory authority of a breach within 72 hours where feasible.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must notify the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of a personal data breach, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk.

requirements.source_locator: Where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
tasks: Collect personal data from the data subject
Provide required transparency information to the data subject
Record completion of the transparency notice
requirements.order_evidence: at the time when personal data are obtained
requirements.constraint_text: at the time when personal data are obtained
requirements.exception_text: Article 13(4) already-has-information exception
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 直接从数据主体收集个人数据时，须在收集时提供规定告知信息。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Direct collection requires specified information at the time of collection.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide the Article 13(1) information at the time personal data are obtained from the data subject.

requirements.source_locator: In addition to the information referred to in paragraph 1, the controller shall, at the time
tasks: Collect personal data from the data subject
Provide further fairness and transparency information to the data subject
Record completion of the further information notice
requirements.order_evidence: at the time when personal data are obtained
requirements.constraint_text: at the time when personal data are obtained
requirements.exception_text: Article 13(4) already-has-information exception
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 直接收集时，还须在收集时提供进一步公平透明处理信息。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Further transparency information must also be provided at the time of direct collection.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide the Article 13(2) further information at the time personal data are obtained.

requirements.source_locator: Where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject, the controller shall provide
tasks: Obtain personal data from a source other than the data subject
Provide required indirect-collection information to the data subject
Record the one-month response deadline
requirements.order_evidence: within a reasonable period after obtaining the personal data, but at the latest within one month
requirements.constraint_text: within a reasonable period after obtaining the personal data, but at the latest within one month
requirements.exception_text: Article 14(5) exceptions may apply
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 间接收集个人数据时，须在合理期限内且最迟一个月内告知数据主体。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Indirect collection requires information within one month.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide Article 14(1) information within a reasonable period and at the latest within one month after obtaining personal data.

requirements.source_locator: In addition to the information referred to in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide
tasks: Obtain personal data from a third-party source
Provide further indirect-collection information to the data subject
Log the information delivery
requirements.order_evidence: within a reasonable period after obtaining the personal data, but at the latest within one month
requirements.constraint_text: within a reasonable period after obtaining the personal data, but at the latest within one month
requirements.exception_text: Article 14(5) exceptions may apply
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 间接收集时，还须在法定期限内提供进一步公平透明处理信息。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Further transparency information from indirect sources is also time-bound.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide Article 14(2) further information within the Article 14(3) timing framework.

requirements.source_locator: Where point (a) of Article 6(1) applies
tasks: Assess the child age and applicable consent route
Verify that parental authorisation has been obtained where required
Process the child personal data for the information society service
requirements.order_evidence: shall be lawful only if and to the extent that consent is given or authorised
requirements.condition_text: child is below 16 years old
requirements.constraint_text: shall be lawful only if and to the extent that consent is given or authorised
requirements.exception_text: child is at least 16 years old; Member State may provide a lower age not below 13
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 向儿童提供信息社会服务时，须根据年龄取得本人或监护人同意。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Child consent for information society services depends on age and parental authorisation.
requirements.normative_content: Processing of a child personal data for information society services is lawful only with age-appropriate consent or parental authorisation.

requirements.source_locator: The controller shall make reasonable efforts to verify
tasks: Log available technology and verification context
Make reasonable efforts to verify parental authorisation
Process the child personal data
requirements.order_evidence: verify in such cases that consent is given or authorised
requirements.condition_text: consent was given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility
requirements.constraint_text: verify in such cases that consent is given or authorised
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 儿童同意场景下，控制者须尽合理努力核验监护人同意。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must make reasonable efforts to verify parental authorisation.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must make reasonable efforts to verify that consent was given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility.

requirements.source_locator: The data subject has given explicit consent to the processing of those personal data
tasks: Identify special-category personal data in scope
Obtain explicit consent from the data subject
Process the special-category personal data
requirements.order_evidence: has given explicit consent to the processing of those personal data
requirements.condition_text: special-category data are processed
requirements.constraint_text: has given explicit consent to the processing of those personal data
requirements.exception_text: Union or Member State law may prohibit lifting the prohibition by consent
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 处理特殊类别数据须取得数据主体明确同意。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Special-category processing requires explicit consent unless law prohibits it.
requirements.normative_content: The Article 9(1) prohibition may be lifted by explicit consent for specified purposes, subject to law.

requirements.source_locator: Processing is necessary for the purposes of carrying out the obligations
tasks: Identify the employment or social-protection processing purpose
Confirm the Union or Member State law or collective agreement basis
Process the special-category personal data
requirements.order_evidence: in so far as it is authorised by Union or Member State law or a collective agreement
requirements.condition_text: processing necessary for employment, social security or social protection law
requirements.constraint_text: in so far as it is authorised by Union or Member State law or a collective agreement
requirements.exception_text: no authorising Union or Member State law or collective agreement
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 基于雇佣或社会保障法处理特殊类别数据须有法定依据和保障。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Employment-law processing of special-category data requires a lawful basis and safeguards.
requirements.normative_content: Processing is permitted where necessary for employment/social-security obligations and authorised by law or collective agreement with safeguards.

requirements.source_locator: The controller shall provide information on action taken on a request
tasks: Receive the data subject request
Provide the response on action taken
Archive the request response record
requirements.order_evidence: without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request
requirements.constraint_text: without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request
requirements.exception_text: extension by two further months is possible with reasons
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 控制者须在收到请求后一个月内告知所采取的行动。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must respond to data subject requests within one month.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must provide information on action taken without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt.

requirements.source_locator: If the controller does not take action on the request of the data subject
tasks: Receive the data subject request
Inform the data subject of the reasons for not taking action
Record the complaint and judicial remedy information
requirements.order_evidence: without delay and at the latest within one month of receipt of the request
requirements.constraint_text: without delay and at the latest within one month of receipt of the request
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 不处理请求时，须在一个月内告知理由和救济途径。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Refusal to act must be explained within one month with remedies.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must inform the data subject of reasons and remedies without delay and at the latest within one month when no action is taken.

requirements.source_locator: The controller shall no longer process the personal data unless
tasks: Receive the data subject objection and particular grounds
Stop processing unless compelling legitimate grounds are demonstrated
Document the assessment of compelling grounds
requirements.order_evidence: shall no longer process the personal data unless
requirements.condition_text: processing based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f)
requirements.constraint_text: shall no longer process the personal data unless
requirements.exception_text: compelling legitimate grounds override the data subject interests or legal claims require processing
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 数据主体基于自身情况反对处理时，控制者原则须停止处理。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Objection requires the controller to stop processing unless compelling grounds exist.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must no longer process personal data after an objection unless it demonstrates compelling legitimate grounds or a legal-claims need.

requirements.source_locator: Where the data subject objects to processing for direct marketing purposes
tasks: Receive the direct-marketing objection
Cease processing for direct-marketing purposes
Record the marketing suppression
requirements.order_evidence: the personal data shall no longer be processed for such purposes
requirements.condition_text: data are processed for direct marketing
requirements.constraint_text: the personal data shall no longer be processed for such purposes
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 数据主体反对直接营销时，须停止为直接营销处理个人数据。
requirements.business_scenario_en: An objection to direct marketing requires cessation of that processing.
requirements.normative_content: Where the data subject objects to direct-marketing processing, the personal data shall no longer be processed for such purposes.

requirements.scenario_zh: 控制者、处理者及第三方职责或通知
requirements.source_locator: the controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures
tasks: Assess processing risks and compliance context
Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures
Review and update the implemented measures where necessary
requirements.order_evidence: Those measures shall be reviewed and updated where necessary
requirements.condition_text: taking into account the risks of varying likelihood and severity
requirements.constraint_text: Those measures shall be reviewed and updated where necessary
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 控制者须实施适当技术组织措施并定期审查更新。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must implement and review compliance measures.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must implement appropriate technical and organisational measures and review/update them where necessary.

requirements.scenario_zh: 控制者、处理者及第三方职责或通知
requirements.source_locator: the controller shall, both at the time of the determination of the means for processing
tasks: Determine the means and purposes of processing
Implement data-protection-by-design safeguards
Carry out the processing operations
requirements.order_evidence: both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself
requirements.condition_text: taking into account state of the art, cost, nature, scope, context, purposes and risks
requirements.constraint_text: both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 控制者须在确定处理方式时及处理过程中落实数据保护设计。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Data protection by design must be implemented at design time and during processing.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must implement appropriate measures and safeguards by design at the determination of means and during processing.

requirements.scenario_zh: 控制者、处理者及第三方职责或通知
requirements.source_locator: the processor processes the personal data only on documented instructions from the controller
tasks: Receive documented processing instructions from the controller
Process personal data only on those documented instructions
Report any instruction that appears to infringe data-protection law
requirements.order_evidence: only on documented instructions from the controller
requirements.condition_text: unless required to do so by Union or Member State law
requirements.constraint_text: only on documented instructions from the controller
requirements.exception_text: processor must inform controller of a legal requirement before processing unless prohibited by important public-interest grounds
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 处理者须仅按控制者书面指示处理个人数据。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The processor must process personal data only on documented controller instructions.
requirements.normative_content: Processor must process personal data only on documented instructions from the controller, subject to limited legal exceptions.

requirements.scenario_zh: 控制者、处理者及第三方职责或通知
requirements.source_locator: The controller shall communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction
tasks: Carry out rectification, erasure, or restriction
Communicate the change to each recipient of the personal data
Inform the data subject about those recipients on request
requirements.order_evidence: The controller shall communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction
requirements.constraint_text: The controller shall communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction
requirements.exception_text: communication proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 更正、删除或限制处理后，控制者须通知接收方。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must notify recipients of rectification, erasure, or restriction.
requirements.normative_content: Controller must communicate rectification, erasure, or restriction to each recipient unless impossible or disproportionate.

requirements.source_locator: The controller shall seek the advice of the data protection officer
tasks: Identify that a DPIA is required
Seek the advice of the data protection officer
Finalise the data protection impact assessment
requirements.order_evidence: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
requirements.condition_text: a DPO is designated
requirements.constraint_text: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 开展数据保护影响评估时，控制者须征求数据保护官意见。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must seek DPO advice when carrying out a DPIA.
requirements.normative_content: The controller shall seek the advice of the data protection officer, where designated, when carrying out a DPIA.

requirements.source_locator: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects
tasks: Identify affected data subjects or representatives
Seek the views of data subjects or their representatives
Carry out the intended processing
requirements.order_evidence: seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing
requirements.condition_text: where appropriate, without prejudice to commercial/public interests or security
requirements.constraint_text: seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing
requirements.exception_text: protection of commercial or public interests or security of processing operations
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 适当情况下，控制者应就预期处理征求数据主体意见。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller should seek data-subject views on intended processing where appropriate.
requirements.normative_content: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing.

requirements.source_locator: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review
tasks: Detect a change in the risk represented by processing
Carry out a review of the DPIA
Update safeguards based on the review
requirements.order_evidence: at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations
requirements.condition_text: risk represented by processing operations changes
requirements.constraint_text: at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 风险变化时，控制者须审查处理是否符合数据保护影响评估。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller must review the DPIA when risk changes.
requirements.normative_content: The controller shall carry out a review to assess whether processing complies with the DPIA at least when the risk changes.

requirements.source_locator: the supervisory authority shall, within period of up to eight weeks of receipt of the request
tasks: Receive the controller consultation request
Provide written advice to the controller
Record any extension and reasons
requirements.order_evidence: within period of up to eight weeks of receipt of the request
requirements.condition_text: intended processing would infringe the Regulation or risk is insufficiently mitigated
requirements.constraint_text: within period of up to eight weeks of receipt of the request
requirements.exception_text: period may be extended by six weeks; periods may be suspended pending requested information
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 监管机构收到事先咨询请求后，应在最长八周内提供书面意见。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The supervisory authority must provide written advice within up to eight weeks of a consultation request.
requirements.normative_content: The supervisory authority shall provide written advice to the controller within up to eight weeks of receipt of the consultation request, subject to extensions.

requirements.source_locator: including the pseudonymisation and encryption of personal data
tasks: Assess the security risk and implementation context
Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures
Review the effectiveness of the security measures
requirements.order_evidence: to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk
requirements.condition_text: risk of varying likelihood and severity for rights and freedoms
requirements.constraint_text: to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 控制者和处理者须实施与风险相适应的安全措施。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The controller and processor must implement risk-appropriate security measures.
requirements.normative_content: The controller and processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

requirements.source_locator: The controller and processor shall take steps to ensure that any natural person
tasks: Provide documented instructions to authorised personnel
Ensure personnel process personal data only on those instructions
Review access and processing compliance
requirements.order_evidence: does not process them except on instructions from the controller
requirements.condition_text: person has access to personal data under controller or processor authority
requirements.constraint_text: does not process them except on instructions from the controller
requirements.exception_text: required to do so by Union or Member State law
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 控制者和处理者须确保授权人员仅按指示处理个人数据。
requirements.business_scenario_en: Authorised personnel must process personal data only on controller instructions.
requirements.normative_content: The controller and processor shall ensure that authorised persons process personal data only on controller instructions unless required by law.

requirements.source_locator: The processor shall notify the controller without undue delay after becoming aware
tasks: Become aware of a personal data breach
Notify the controller of the personal data breach
Record the processor notification
requirements.order_evidence: without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach
requirements.constraint_text: without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 处理者知悉个人数据泄露后，须及时通知控制者。
requirements.business_scenario_en: The processor must notify the controller of a breach without undue delay.
requirements.normative_content: The processor shall notify the controller without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach.

requirements.source_locator: When the personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk
tasks: Assess that the breach is likely to result in high risk
Communicate the personal data breach to the data subject
Record the communication
requirements.order_evidence: without undue delay
requirements.condition_text: breach likely to result in high risk to rights and freedoms
requirements.constraint_text: without undue delay
requirements.exception_text: Article 34(3) exceptions may apply
requirements.business_scenario_zh: 泄露可能对数据主体权利自由造成高风险时，控制者须及时告知数据主体。
requirements.business_scenario_en: High-risk breaches must be communicated to data subjects without undue delay.
requirements.normative_content: The controller shall communicate a high-risk personal data breach to the data subject without undue delay.
